item.title: Taylor Fresh Foods Inc: Salsa Fresca Medium. Recall
item.summary: Potential contamination with Salmonella. Product details: Salsa Fresca Medium. Ingredients: Tomato, Yellow Onion, Jalapeno Pepper, Pasteurized Lemon Juice, Garlic, Salt, Cilantro, Ground Cumin. Net Wt: 12 oz. Keep Refrigerated. Distributed By: Taylor Farms Inc., Salinas, CA 93902. UPC: 030223075080
item.affectedPeople: Domestic: AL, AR, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, MA, ME, MI, MN, MO, MS, NC, NE, NH, NY, OH, OK, SC, TN, TX, VT, WI, WV. Foreign: Not applicable.
item.remedy: Affected quantity: Illinois: 3,360 units; Texas: 2,040 units
item.payoutAmount: Refund, replacement, correction, or disposal if stated by the official notice
